description.value:
Exploding Water Shockwave. Kisame's signature jutsu. You expel a tidal volume of water from your mouth that quickly floods the area in a 30-foot emanation, then surges outward as a single crushing shockwave.

Creatures in the area take 10d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save; the area floods to 5 feet deep for 10 minutes (or 1 minute if there is no natural drainage), counting as difficult terrain that grants concealment to creatures fully submerged.

You can ride the wave: you may Stride up to twice your Speed in the affected area as part of casting.
